# Badook (בדוק)

> Badook is a Hebrew-first service for designing, sending and managing digital invitations — weddings, bar and bat mitzvahs, brit milah, henna, engagements, baby showers, birthdays and corporate events. Guests open a link on their phone, answer the RSVP, and the host follows replies, seating and a live photo gallery.

## Pages

- [Home](https://invitations.badooks.com/): what Badook does, sample invitations, designs, pricing and questions (Hebrew)
- [Home in English](https://invitations.badooks.com/en): the same page in English
- [Contact](https://invitations.badooks.com/contact): questions and support
- [Privacy policy](https://invitations.badooks.com/privacy)
- [Terms of use](https://invitations.badooks.com/terms)
- [Accessibility statement](https://invitations.badooks.com/accessibility)

## Notes

- Each invitation lives at /i/<name> and is private to whoever has the link; invitations are not indexed.
- The host app (/app) requires signing in.
